description: UI harness + dispatcher split-queue acceptance (#109): clicking the armed AE stopwatch enqueues ClearPropertyKeyframes at runtime, and the script can observe its effect on the very next commands -- impossible before the runtime/script queue split. The **/ wildcard crosses PropertyWindow's PushID(entity) scope; '(*)' is the armed-stopwatch label, and Opacity is the only armed property so it is unambiguous.
